title: Train QM9-SchNet Ensemble (QM9-SE) from scratch
action: Train a SchNet model with DPOSE (64 independent output heads, Negative Log-Likelihood loss) from scratch on the full QM9 dataset (130,831 molecules) using an 80/20 train‑test split. Obtain a trained QM9‑SE model.
description: Prerequisite for QM9 evaluation; the trained model is needed to compute predictive variances and R².

title: Fine-tune OC20-SchNet Ensemble (OC20-SE) on intermetallic slabs
action: Load the pretrained SchNet checkpoint, add DPOSE heads (64 output heads), and fine‑tune on the intermetallic slab subset of the OC20 dataset, freezing all upstream weights. Obtain the OC20‑SE model.
description: Prerequisite for OC20 evaluation; the fine‑tuned model specializes in intermetallic slabs.

title: Fine-tune AuMD-SE model on bulk gold systems
action: Using the same pretrained SchNet checkpoint, add DPOSE heads and fine‑tune on the bulk gold configurations from the Gold dataset, freezing upstream weights. Obtain the AuMD‑SE model.
description: Prerequisite for gold vs silver evaluation; the model specializes on gold bulk structures.

title: Evaluate all models and produce summary
action: Use the trained QM9‑SE model to compute predictive variance for the specified in‑domain (CF₄, CH₄, HF) and out‑of‑domain (CCl₄, SiH₄, HCl, SiF₄, SiCl₄) molecules, and compute R² on the QM9 test split. Use the fine‑tuned OC20‑SE model to compute median predictive variance over intermetallic and non‑metal slab subsets and R² on the intermetallic test set. Use the fine‑tuned AuMD‑SE model to compute mean predictive variance for gold structures and for analogous silver structures. Aggregate all results into a single JSON file.
description: Final artifact that captures all mandatory quantitative comparisons: variance differences between in‑domain and out‑of‑domain data, and regression quality on in‑domain test splits.
output_schema:
{
  "qm9_in_domain_variance": [float] (variance for CF₄, CH₄, HF),
  "qm9_out_of_domain_variance": [float] (variance for CCl₄, SiH₄, HCl, SiF₄, SiCl₄),
  "oc20_intermetallic_variance_median": float,
  "oc20_nonmetal_variance_median": float,
  "gold_variance_au_mean": float,
  "gold_variance_ag_mean": float,
  "qm9_test_R2": float,
  "oc20_intermetallic_test_R2": float
}
